metadata.title: Classification of real Lie algebras of dimension six
metadata.abstract: We summarize a coordinate-free classification of six-dimensional real Lie algebras up to isomorphism. Instead of solving the overdetermined Jacobi system of 120 quadratic equations on 90 structure constants modulo $\mathrm{GL}(6,\mathbb{R})$, the method uses the Levi--Malcev decomposition, Mostow's nilradical constraints, and the Skjelbred--Sund cohomological central extension technique. In the semisimple sector, the four real forms of $A_1\oplus A_1$ are classified by Killing signature invariants, with explicit matrix representatives for $\mathfrak{sl}(2,\mathbb{C})_{\mathbb{R}}\cong\mathfrak{so}(3,1)$. For non-solvable algebras with three-dimensional radical, representation-theoretic rigidity shows that $\mathfrak{su}(2)$ cannot couple indecomposably with non-abelian radicals, yielding exactly three indecomposable classes governed by $\mathfrak{so}(3)$ and $\mathfrak{sl}(2,\mathbb{R})$. In the solvable category, Mostow's theorem restricts the nilradical dimension to $\{3,4,5,6\}$. The nilpotent sector in dimension six has twenty-four indecomposable isomorphism classes plus decomposable counterparts. Solvable non-nilpotent algebras are classified by nilradical codimension, with explicit real Jordan matrix representations for codimension one and two that resolve continuous moduli under gauge actions. The work also computes the minimal faithful representation dimension $\mu(\mathfrak{g})$ under Ado's theorem, relates the classification to invariant complex structures on nilmanifolds, and provides a deterministic, page-breakable identification algorithm.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 六维实Lie代数的结构化分类整理
analysis.workSummary: 用Levi–Malcev分解、幂零根基约束与中心扩张整理六维实Lie代数同构分类，并给矩阵代表和确定性识别算法。
analysis.breakthrough: 涵盖半单部分、三维根基的非可解类及不同余维的可解类，另计算最小忠实表示维数并联系不变复结构。
analysis.limitations: 主体总结既有分类，精确参数去重、实形式、表示维数与算法正确性需核对。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。16页PDF完整提取，全文候选、声明位置及点写/断行模型名型号、HyProver/Hunyuan/Danus补检未观察到生成式AI实际使用披露。

analysis.priorityReason: 为齐性几何提供代数底表，与当前分析主线联系间接。
